clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Medical device OEMs (minimally invasive surgery, wound care, orthopedics, wearables), plus aerospace, defense, automotive and industrial packaging and components

consumables_service_attachment.value: Recurring custom production for OEM customers; design, prototyping, high-volume manufacturing, packaging and supply chain services; single-use devices

notes: UFP is a contract manufacturer; device clearances typically belong to its OEM customers, and the evidence does not state them.
